parameters.title: ={{ $('webhook-entity').item.json.business_name }} — Entity Consistency Checklist
parameters.content:
=# Entity Consistency Checklist

Paste these EXACT values into every platform listed below.
Consistency across all platforms is the #1 trigger for a Google Knowledge Panel.

---

## Business Name (use EXACTLY this, everywhere)
{{ $json.entity_consistency_checklist.business_name }}

## Short Description (155 chars — for GBP, directories, bios)
{{ $json.entity_consistency_checklist.short_description }}

## Long Description (500 chars — for LinkedIn, Facebook, website About)
{{ $json.entity_consistency_checklist.long_description }}

## Phone
{{ $json.entity_consistency_checklist.phone }}

## Website
{{ $json.entity_consistency_checklist.website }}

## Address
{{ $json.entity_consistency_checklist.address }}

---

## Platforms to Update:
- [ ] Website (footer + About page)
- [ ] Google Business Profile
- [ ] LinkedIn Company Page
- [ ] Facebook Business Page
- [ ] Instagram Business Profile
- [ ] YouTube Channel About
- [ ] Twitter/X Bio
- [ ] TrueLocal
- [ ] Yellow Pages AU
- [ ] Yelp AU
- [ ] Wikidata (auto-submitted)
- [ ] Crunchbase (auto-submitted)

---

## Google Knowledge Panel Claim
Once your Knowledge Panel appears (allow 4-8 weeks after Wikidata submission):
1. Search your business name on Google
2. Click 'Claim this knowledge panel'
3. Use this description when prompted:

{{ $json.google_knowledge_panel_claim_description }}
